idea: Add a partition recurrence: split the unit square into a j×j grid of equal sub-squares (j=2,3,4) and give each sub-square its own count n_i with Σn_i = n. This gives f(n) ≥ (1/j)·max Σ f(n_i), computed by a knapsack over a best[] table built bottom-up. Unlike single-square substitution, the extra count is spread over all cells, which reaches mixed-parity counts.
